title: Card authorizations timing out at payment processor
summary: Upstream processor latency exceeded the 8s gateway timeout. Authorizations were placed but our side recorded failures. Holds auto-released within 3 business days; affected customers were not charged.
resolution: Raised processor timeout to 15s and added idempotent retry on authorization capture.

title: Duplicate invoice emails after billing deploy
summary: A retry loop in the billing worker re-sent invoice emails. No duplicate charges.
resolution: Rolled back deploy; added dedupe key to email outbox.

title: Checkout page 502s during CDN failover
summary: CDN failover sent traffic to a cold origin pool. Some checkout attempts failed before reaching payments.
